name: Mother Fissure
description: the crack that breeds the Road's whelps: a huge lumpy demon mother made of cracked black basalt, a giant glowing orange fissure splitting her belly open, little whelp heads peeking out of it, long sagging arms, small horns, tired furious eyes

poses.stand: hovering low, her glowing fissure belly open, whelp heads peeking out
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, breathing heavily, her belly fissure pulsing with light

attack.action: heaves and spits a glowing lump of magma forward to the right out of her fissure

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
